tools.name: printposs_list_stores
tools.description: List the seller's connected stores (for example Shopify or Etsy shops). Use a store id as store_id when creating an order. GET /api/v1/seller/stores.

tools.name: printposs_list_products
tools.description: List the print-on-demand products with their variants (device model, colour, product_variant_id). Use a product_variant_id from this list in printposs_create_order. GET /api/v1/seller/products.

tools.name: printposs_list_orders
tools.description: List the seller's fulfillment orders with status (order_status, payment_status), external_order_id and totals. GET /api/v1/seller/orders.

tools.name: printposs_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its PrintPoss order_number, with optional items, packages (tracking), costs and refunds. GET /api/v1/seller/orders/{order_number}.

tools.name: printposs_list_wallet_transactions
tools.description: List wallet transactions (top-ups, order payments, refunds) with balance_after. Use it to check spend per order. GET /api/v1/seller/wallet-transactions.

tools.name: printposs_get_webhook_setup
tools.description: Read which webhook events (order.shipped, package.in_transit, package.delivered) are set up and their URLs. The header secret is not shown. GET /api/v1/seller/webhooks.

tools.name: printposs_create_order
tools.description: Create a print-on-demand order that PrintPoss prints and ships to the buyer. It charges the seller's PrintPoss wallet and cannot be cancelled by this tool. Use a unique external_order_id: a repeated id is rejected, so a retry cannot double-charge. Get product_variant_id from printposs_list_products

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "printposs_get_webhook_setup" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: printposs_get_webhook_setup, printposs_create_order · Private data: printposs_list_wallet_transactions, printposs_get_webhook_setup, printposs_create_order · Public sink: printposs_get_webhook_setup, printposs_create_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: printposs_get_webhook_setup, printposs_create_order · Private data: printposs_list_wallet_transactions, printposs_get_webhook_setup, printposs_create_order · Public sink: printposs_get_webhook_setup, printposs_create_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
